title: Choke
author: Chuck Palahniuk
summary: Victor Mancini, a sex addict who works at a colonial theme park, makes money by pretending to choke in restaurants. His mother's decline in a care home raises questions about his past.
readIf: you like transgressive, darkly comic fiction with an unreliable narrator.
skipIf: you are bothered by crude sexual content or bleak humour.
